policy.original_scope: Chapter13 D01 bounded selected boundaries, not full unrelated Cartesian product. Existing B05/C16 results immutable; no rerun of their rosters.
policy.diagnostic_deck: Owned legal mixed 20-card diagnostic; P0 is not a new-account population model.
policy.growth_input: Permanent card/weapon growth P0..P5 projected to min(growth,D), season armor levels 0/0/1/2/3/5 not projected; quality caps enforced.
policy.prior_monster_cards: 0/5/10/15 reconstructed prior-state cards at base0, explicitly not claimed actual prior-route kills; every new actual kill must auto-add species card into discard.
policy.observed_outcomes: Win, Dead and Timeout at600s are observations. Low-growth D5 death is not a health anomaly; Timeout is retained and not called terminal. D01 functional boundary acceptance never implies D03 viability, duration, efficiency or population acceptance.
